exams.notes: Dentists shall pass an examination approved by a majority of the dentist members of the dental board; the compact requires acceptance of JCNDE national board examinations.

exams.quote: Accept the national board examinations of the joint commission on national dental examinations or another examination accepted by commission rule as a licensure examination.

exams.notes: A clinical assessment providing evidence of clinical competence is required for licensure.

required.quote: Have continuing professional development requirements as a condition for license renewal.

value: opioid prescribing continuing education (for those who prescribed opioids in previous licensure cycle)
topical_requirements.quote: The board of medicine, board of dentistry, board of physician assistants, board of podiatry, and board of nursing shall establish rules requiring a person licensed pursuant to section 148.3, 148C.3, 149.3, or 152.6 or chapter 153 who has prescribed opioids to a patient during the previous licensure cycle to receive continuing education credits regarding the United States centers for disease control and prevention guideline for prescribing opioids

available.quote: The board may issue a license under this chapter without examination to an applicant who furnishes satisfactory proof that the applicant meets all of the following requirements: 1. Holds a license from a similar dental board of another state, territory, or district of the United States under requirements equivalent or substantially equivalent to those of this state.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license from a similar dental board of another state under substantially equivalent requirements, and must have either passed an approved regional or national examination or have been in legal practice for 3 consecutive years immediately prior to filing.
requirements.quote: Holds a license from a similar dental board of another state, territory, or district of the United States under requirements equivalent or substantially equivalent to those of this state. 2. Has satisfied at least one of the following: a. Passed an examination administered by a regional or national testing service, which examination has been approved by the dental board in accordance with section 147.34, subsection 1. b. Has for three consecutive years immediately prior to the filing of the application in this state been in a legal practice of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring the license or its renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For fraud or deceit in procuring the license or registration or the renewal thereof to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and gross malpractice or willful and gross neglect in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For being guilty of willful and gross malpractice or willful and gross neglect in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in representation as to skill or ability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For fraud in representation as to skill or ability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violations of the chapter, subtitle, or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For willful or repeated violations of this chapter, this subtitle, or the rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay license or registration fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For having failed to pay license or registration fees as provided herein.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross immorality or dishonorable or unprofessional conduct in the practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For gross immorality or dishonorable or unprofessional conduct in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a reasonably satisfactory standard of competency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For failure to maintain a reasonably satisfactory standard of competency in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a law of this state, another state, or the United States relating to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For a violation of a law of this state, another state, or the United States, without regard to its designation as either a felony or misdemeanor, which law relates to the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action by a licensing authority of another state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation or suspension of a license or registration to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting or other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising a person to unlawfully practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising a person to unlawfully practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of mental incompetence by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For an adjudication of mental incompetence by a court of competent jurisdiction. Such adjudication shall automatically suspend a license or registration for the duration of the license or registration unless the board orders otherwise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, drunkenness, or habitual use of drugs or other mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, drunkenness, or habitual or excessive use of drugs, intoxicants, narcotics, chemicals, or other types of materials or as a result of a mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being a party to or assisting in any violation of any provision of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For being a party to or assisting in any violation of any provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: For a dental hygienist, practicing dentistry; or for a dentist, permitting a hygienist under supervision to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For a dental hygienist, the practice of dentistry by the dental hygienist; and for a dentist, permitting the practice of dentistry by a dental hygienist by the dentist under whose supervision the dental hygienist is operating.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate accompanying license renewal application is not in all material respects true
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A license to practice either dentistry or dental hygiene, or registration as a dental assistant, shall be revoked or suspended in the manner and upon the grounds elsewhere provided in this chapter, and also when the certificate accompanying the application of such licensee or registrant for renewal of license or registration filed with the board is not in all material respects true.

definition_quote.value: Persons who perform examination, diagnosis, treatment, and attempted correction by any medicine, appliance, surgery, or other appropriate method of any disease, condition, disorder, lesion, injury, deformity, or defect of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area, including teeth, gums, jaws, and associated structures and tissue

value: supervision of a licensed dentist (for therapeutic/preventive services)
no supervision required for educational services

teledentistry_authorized.quote: The licensee performs an initial in-person or teledentistry examination of the teeth and supporting structures of the new patient prior to beginning orthodontic treatment.
